_note: What the client physically receives for each deliverable (José, Oct 19). One source for the Deliverable agent's checks; workplan.py keeps the same ids, labels and defaults for the slide icons (tests/test_formats.py keeps them in step). A workshop is not a format: it is how work is done, and its output is a presentation, report or playbook.

formats.label: Report
formats.what: a written document read on its own

formats.label: Model
formats.what: a spreadsheet the client can rerun: a business case, cost or sizing model

formats.label: Dashboard
formats.what: a tracker the client keeps updating: KPIs, savings, progress

formats.label: Playbook
formats.what: procedures, roles and rules the client's people follow

formats.label: Working solution
formats.what: something running: a prototype, a configured system, a pilot in operation
